title: eval-harness: add CI prompt-regression gating and eval-metrics integration
author: Aisha Patel
release_notes: Add CI gate to fail PRs when prompt-set quality drops beyond threshold; integrate eval metrics report generation and summary artifact
description: Motivation: We need an automated CI gate that prevents regressions in prompt-set quality when changes touch model-serving, prompting helpers, or evaluation configs. This PR adds a CI job that runs the eval-harness against a set of canonical prompt-sets and computes a small set of eval metrics (accuracy/macro-F1/response-acceptance) and fails the job if configured thresholds are exceeded. The goal is to catch regressions introduced by model changes, prompt formatting, or input preprocessing before they reach main. Changes include: 1) new GitHub Actions workflow to run the eval-harness on PRs that touch relevant paths; 2) a lightweight runner and integration layer that produces compact JSON metric artifacts and an HTML summary for quick review; 3) threshold/config support via .eval/config.yaml with overrides for repository owners; 4) artifact upload to the PR and a human-readable summary in the Checks output; 5) support for an opt-out label (ci/no-eval-gate) and an allowlist for large experimental PRs. Checklist: - [x] baseline metric collection + runner - [x] workflow and artifact upload - [x] threshold config and defaults - [x] retries for flaky tests - [x] docs and local run instructions - [x] unit + integration tests
commits_summary: 3 commits: initial eval-harness CI runner scaffold; add metrics integration and summary artifact; fix flaky test timing and add retry logic
files_changed_summary: .github/workflows/eval-harness-ci.yml (new workflow), scripts/run_eval_ci.py (entrypoint), eval_harness/runner.py (CI runner hooks), eval_harness/metrics/report.py (metric summarization and HTML), tests/test_prompts_regression.py (integration test), .eval/config.yaml (thresholds defaults), docs/ci.md (how CI gate works and opt-outs)
review_comments_summary: Reviewers requested clearer failure messages, upload of both JSON and HTML artifacts, and defensive parsing of legacy prompt-set schemas. Also asked for opt-out label behavior and documentation to be explicit. Author addressed comments: added artifact links to check output, improved schema validation, and added a metrics sample to the docs.
ci_checks_summary: Checks: lint (flake8) - pass; unit-tests (pytest) - pass; mypy - pass; eval-harness-integration - failed on first run due to test timing; rerun succeeded; coverage - pass. Full eval run takes ~6m on ubuntu-latest; artifacts uploaded to 'eval-harness/results/<pr-number>'.
notes_on_thresholds: Default thresholds (stored in .eval/config.yaml): macro_f1_drop_pct: 2.0, sample_acceptance_drop_pct: 5.0. Thresholds are configurable per-repo and per-branch via the config file. Gate behavior: fail CI if any metric exceeds threshold; allowlist and exempt-labels supported.
manual_test_instructions: Run locally: python scripts/run_eval_ci.py --prompt-set examples/prompt_sets/default.json --output ./out --thresholds .eval/config.yaml. CI-local mode mirrors the GH Actions environment; see docs/ci.md for examples. Use --retries N to reproduce flaky behavior.
risk_and_mitigation: Risk: noisy failures due to upstream model nondeterminism or infra flakiness. Mitigation: conservative default thresholds, retry logic for CI job, and an opt-out label for large experimental PRs. Monitoring: we emit per-run metrics to the existing metrics pipeline and will add a weekly alert on gate failure rate.
author_reply_summary: Addressed requested changes within 2 rounds of review: added artifact upload, tightened schema validation, and documented opt-out behavior. Asked reviewers to pilot on a small internal repo for 2 weeks before org-wide enforcement.
backcompat_notes: No breaking public API changes. CI-only hooks and an opt-in label; runtime behavior unchanged. Schema validation added with clear migration notes in docs.
testing_summary: Added unit tests for metrics/report.py and an end-to-end integration test test_prompts_regression.py that runs a tiny prompt-set against a mocked runner. Integration test marked stable after flakiness fixes.
changelog_entry: CI: Add eval-harness prompt-regression CI gate with artifact summaries and configurable thresholds
